cases.title: FM services RFP — full brief, approved evaluation criteria, legal template available

inputs.category: Integrated facilities management — cleaning, security, catering

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
RFx pack includes: instructions to bidders, requirements by section, pricing schedule, evaluation criteria
pricing template accommodates open-book model
legal review flagged as required before issue
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
no requirements section references a specific incumbent's solution or brand name

cases.title: Category name only — no requirements, no pricing structure, no evaluation criteria
pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: requirements not defined, pricing model not specified, evaluation criteria not agreed
skill does not generate an RFx without substantive requirements input
open_questions contains at least: scope of services, pricing model, evaluation criteria

cases.title: Requirements reference a specific OEM product despite technology-neutral instruction

inputs.instruction: Technology-neutral — we want the best solution for our sites.
inputs.requirements_draft: The system must use Siemens Desigo CC as the core platform with native Siemens integration protocols.

pass_signals: conflict between technology-neutral instruction and OEM-specific requirement is explicitly surfaced
skill does not publish the OEM-specific requirement without flagging it as a supplier bias risk
risk_flags contains: requirements reference Siemens Desigo CC — contradicts technology-neutral instruction
open_questions contains: confirm whether OEM lock-in is intentional or should requirements be generalised?
confidence_level is MEDIUM — RFx is structurally ready but one section requires user decision

cases.title: RFx issue requested before G3 evaluation framework approval gate is confirmed

inputs.user_instruction: Just send it out — the framework is good enough.

pass_signals: skill does not issue the RFx without G3 gate confirmation
risk_flags contains: G3 approval gate not confirmed — RFx must not be issued
risk_flags contains: legal review pending
escalation_required is true
status is blocked — not completed
skill explicitly states what approvals are required before issue proceeds
